shorts.title: Japanese Honeybees Can Cook a Giant Hornet Alive
shorts.outro: Doug tried it in a hornet costume. That's in the full video below.
shorts.description: Japanese honeybees ball up around a giant hornet and heat it to about 46 C, just four degrees short of killing themselves, and the full giant hornet episode is linked below.

shorts.title: A Tree in Washington Was Hiding a Nest Full of Hornet Queens
shorts.hook: This tree in Washington was hiding a giant hornet nest.
shorts.outro: Doug held that tree open. It's in the full video below.
shorts.description: In 2020 Washington's agriculture department tracked a giant hornet home with a radio tied on by dental floss and found a nest with 76 queens already out, and the full giant hornet episode is linked below.

shorts.title: One Giant Hornet Can Kill Up to 40 Bees a Minute
shorts.outro: Doug got put in the middle of that hive. Full video below.
shorts.description: A single giant hornet can kill up to 40 honeybees a minute with nothing but its jaws, and a small group can empty a 30,000-bee hive in hours; the full giant hornet episode is linked below.
